meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会让你在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`。该脚本会自动完成 NanoClaw 的依赖、容器镜像、凭据等初始设置,并在出错时提供 Claude 辅助恢复、从断点继续。
howto.when: 当用户要求安装、配置 NanoClaw 或进行首次设置时触发,涉及“setup”、“install”、“configure nanoclaw”等关键词。

say.note: Claude 会引导你运行安装脚本。
脚本会自动处理依赖和凭据。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will tell you to run `bash nanoclaw.sh` in your terminal. The script handles the initial NanoClaw setup including dependencies, container image, and credentials; if an error occurs, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes from where it stopped.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to install or configure NanoClaw, or go through first-time setup. Keywords include "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run the setup script.
This will trigger the first-time setup flow.

say_en.text: I want to do the initial NanoClaw setup
say_en.note: The script will handle dependencies and credentials.
